title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三: 太宗上
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三: 太宗上 Volume 3 Annals 3: Taizong 1

sentences.zh: 太宗上

translations.literal: Taizong, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, Part One

sentences.zh: 太宗孝武惠文皇帝，諱德光，字德謹，小字堯骨。

translations.literal: The Taizong, Emperor of Filial Martial Bounty and Cultured Letters — taboo name Deguang, courtesy name Dejin, childhood name Yaogu.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, styled the Filial Martial Bounty and Cultured Letters Emperor, bore the taboo name Deguang, courtesy name Dejin, and childhood name Yaogu.

sentences.zh: 太祖第二子，母淳欽皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: The Taizu's second son; his mother was Empress Chunqin, née Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: He was the Taizu's second son, born to Empress Chunqin of the Xiao clan.

sentences.zh: 唐天復二年生，神光異常，獵者獲白鹿、白鷹，人以為瑞。

translations.literal: Born in the second year of Tang Tianfu, divine light was unusual; hunters captured a white deer and a white hawk, and people took them as auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the second year of the Tang Tianfu era (902). Unusual divine light attended his birth, and hunters took a white deer and a white hawk—signs the people read as heaven's favor.

sentences.zh: 及長，貌嚴重而性寬仁，軍國之務多所取決。

translations.literal: When grown, his appearance was stern and dignified yet his nature generous and humane; he decided many affairs of army and state.
translations.idiomatic: Grown to manhood, he looked grave and imposing yet was by nature generous and humane, and on many matters of army and state his word prevailed.

sentences.zh: 天贊元年，授天下兵馬大元帥，尋詔統六軍南徇地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianzan, he was appointed Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven, and soon received orders to command the Six Armies southward to conquer territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianzan he was made Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven, and soon after was ordered to lead the Six Armies south in conquest.

sentences.zh: 明年，下平州，獲趙思溫、張崇。

translations.literal: The next year he took Pingzhou and captured Zhao Siwen and Zhang Chong.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he seized Pingzhou, taking Zhao Siwen and Zhang Chong prisoner.

sentences.zh: 回破箭笴山胡遜奚，諸部悉降。

translations.literal: On the return he broke the Xi chief Husun at Arrow Mountain, and all the tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the homeward march he routed the Xi chieftain Husun at Arrow Mountain, and every tribe submitted.

sentences.zh: 復以兵掠鎮、定，所至皆堅壁不敢戰。

translations.literal: Again he led troops to raid Zhen and Ding; wherever he went, they fortified and dared not give battle.
translations.idiomatic: He marched again against Zhen and Ding; everywhere his host appeared, the enemy barricaded themselves and would not fight.

sentences.zh: 師次幽州，符存審拒于州南，縱兵邀擊，大破之，擒裨將裴信等數十人。

translations.literal: The army halted at Youzhou; Fu Cunshen resisted south of the prefecture, sent troops to intercept, was greatly defeated, and Deputy Generals Pei Xin and several dozen men were captured.
translations.idiomatic: When the army camped at Youzhou, Fu Cunshen made a stand south of the city and sent troops to intercept; he was routed, and Deputy General Pei Xin and dozens of others were taken.

sentences.zh: 及從太祖破于厥里諸部，定河壖党項，下山西諸鎮，取回鶻單于城，東平渤海，破達盧古部，東西萬里，所向皆有功。

translations.literal: Moreover, following the Taizu he broke the Yujueli tribes, settled the Tangut along the Yellow River banks, took the commanderies of Shanxi, seized the Uyghur Chanyu City, pacified Bohai to the east, and broke the Dalugu — ten thousand li east and west, wherever he went there was achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Taizu he crushed the Yujueli tribes, subjugated the Tangut along the riverbanks, overran the garrisons of Shanxi, took the Uyghur Chanyu City, subdued Bohai in the east, and broke the Dalugu — over ten thousand li in every direction he won distinction.

sentences.zh: 天顯元、二年

translations.literal: First and Second Years of Tianxian
translations.idiomatic: First and Second Years of Tianxian

sentences.zh: 天顯元年七月，太祖崩，皇后攝軍國事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Tianxian, the Taizu died, and the Empress assumed charge of military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Tianxian's first year the Taizu died, and the Empress Dowager assumed regency over army and state.

sentences.zh: 明年秋，治祖陵畢。

translations.literal: The next autumn, work on the ancestral tombs was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The following autumn the ancestral tombs were finished.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬戌，人皇王倍率羣臣請于后曰：「皇子大元帥勳望，中外攸屬，宜承大統。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on renxu day, the Human Sovereign King Bei led the ministers to petition the Empress, saying: "The Crown Prince and Grand Marshal's merit and repute — within and without all look to him; he should inherit the great succession.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month on renxu day, the Human Sovereign King Bei led the court in petition to the Empress: "The Prince, Grand Marshal — the realm looks to his merit and prestige; he should take up the Great Succession.

sentences.zh: 」后從之。

translations.literal: " The Empress agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress assented.

sentences.zh: 是日即皇帝位。

translations.literal: That same day he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: That day he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On guihai day he visited the Taizu temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he paid homage at the Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，行柴冊禮。

translations.literal: On bingyin day he performed the firewood-pledge rite.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day he performed the ceremonial investiture rite.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，還都。

translations.literal: On wuchen day he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御宣政殿，羣臣上尊號曰嗣聖皇帝。

translations.literal: On renshen day he presided in the Xuanzheng Hall; the ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Succeeds the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he took his seat in the Hall of Promulgating Governance; the ministers presented the elevated title Emperor Who Succeeds the Sage.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 有司請改元，不許。

translations.literal: The relevant offices requested a change of era name; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Officials petitioned to change the era name; he refused.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，尊皇太后為太皇太后，皇后為應天皇太后，立妃蕭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on gengchen day, the Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager, the Empress as Yingtian Grand Empress Dowager, and Consort Xiao was installed as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, he raised the Empress Dowager to Grand Empress Dowager and the reigning Empress to Yingtian Grand Empress Dowager, and crowned Consort Xiao as Empress.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，閱近侍班局。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, he inspected the attendants' roster and arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: After the ceremonies he reviewed the roster of personal attendants.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，諸道將帥辭歸鎮。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the generals of all circuits took leave and returned to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the military governors of every circuit took leave and returned to their commands.

sentences.zh: 己丑，祀天地。

translations.literal: On jichou day he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day he offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣使諭諸國。

translations.literal: On gengyin day he dispatched envoys to notify the various states.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he sent envoys to announce his accession to the tributary states.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，閱羣牧于近郊。

translations.literal: On xinmao day he inspected the herds in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day he reviewed the imperial herds in the outskirts of the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Jurchen envoys arrived bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On renyin day he visited the Taizu temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day he again paid homage at the Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，閱旗鼓、客省諸局官屬。

translations.literal: On jiachen day he inspected the officials of the Banners and Drums, Guest Reception, and other offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day he reviewed the personnel of the banner, drum, and guest-reception bureaus.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔選遙輦氏九帳子弟可任官者。

translations.literal: On dingwei day an edict ordered the selection of Yaolian clan descendants from the nine tents fit to hold office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict called for suitable sons of the nine Yaolian tents to be chosen for office.

sentences.zh: 天顯三年

translations.literal: Third Year of Tianxian
translations.idiomatic: Third Year of Tianxian

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己酉，閱北剋兵籍。

translations.literal: In the third year, on jiyou day in the first month of spring, he inspected the northern troop registers.
translations.idiomatic: In his third year, on jiyou day in the first month of spring, he reviewed the northern military rolls.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，閱南剋兵籍。

translations.literal: On gengxu day he inspected the southern troop registers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he reviewed the southern military rolls.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，閱皮室、拽剌、墨離三軍。

translations.literal: On dingsi day he inspected the three armies: Pishi, Zhuaila, and Moli.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day he inspected the Pishi, Zhuaila, and Moli armies.

sentences.zh: 己未，黃龍府羅涅河女直、達盧古來貢。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the Jurchen of Luonie River in Huanglong Prefecture and the Dalugu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jurchen from Luonie River in Huanglong Prefecture and the Dalugu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以王郁為興國軍節度使，守中書令。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Wang Yu was made Military Governor of the Xingguo Army and continued as Palace Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Wang Yu was appointed Military Governor of the Xingguo Army while retaining his post as Palace Secretary.

sentences.zh: 二月，辛長濼。

translations.literal: In the second month, he proceeded to Changbo.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he traveled to Changbo.

sentences.zh: 己亥，惕隱涅里袞進白狼。

translations.literal: On jihai day Chief Minister Nieli Gun presented a white wolf.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Nieli Gun, Chief Minister, presented a white wolf.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，達盧古來貢。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Dalugu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Dalugu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，東蒐。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yimao day, he hunted to the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao day, he rode east on the hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，獵羖豕山。

translations.literal: On guihai day he hunted at Mountain of Wild Boars.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he hunted at Wild Boar Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，獵松山。

translations.literal: On yichou day he hunted at Pine Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day he hunted at Pine Mountain.

sentences.zh: 唐義武軍節度使王都遣人以定州來歸。

translations.literal: Wang Du, Military Governor of Tang's Yiwu Army, sent men bringing Dingzhou to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Du, Tang's governor of the Yiwu Army, dispatched envoys offering Dingzhou in surrender.

sentences.zh: 唐主出師討之，使來乞援，命奚禿里鐵剌往救之。

translations.literal: The Tang ruler sent troops to attack him; envoys came begging relief, and orders were issued for Tieci of the Xi Tulii tribe to go rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang emperor marched against him; Wang Du sent envoys pleading for aid, and the court ordered Tieci of the Xi Tulii to his relief.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，東巡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on wuyin day, he toured east.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuyin day, he made an eastern progress.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祭麃鹿神。

translations.literal: On jimao day he sacrificed to the Elk Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he offered sacrifice to the Elk Spirit.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，於獵所縱公私取羽毛革木之材。

translations.literal: On dinghai day at the hunt grounds, private and public persons were permitted to take feather, hide, and wood materials.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day at the hunting grounds he permitted all to gather feathers, hides, and wood.

sentences.zh: 甲午，取箭材赤山。

translations.literal: On jiawu day arrow wood was taken at Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day they cut arrowwood on Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，獵三山。

translations.literal: On bingshen day he hunted at Three Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day he hunted at Three Mountains.

sentences.zh: 鐵剌敗唐將王晏球于定州。

translations.literal: Tieci defeated Tang general Wang Yanqiu at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tieci routed Tang general Wang Yanqiu at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 唐兵大集，鐵剌請益師。

translations.literal: Tang forces massed in strength; Tieci requested reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Tang armies massed; Tieci asked for more troops.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命惕隱涅里袞、都統查剌赴之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Chief Minister Nieli Gun and Commander Chala were ordered to go aid him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Nieli Gun and Commander Chala were dispatched to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，建天膳堂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingwu day, the Heavenly Feast Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu day, the Heavenly Feast Hall was erected.

sentences.zh: 獵索剌山。

translations.literal: He hunted at Suola Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He hunted at Suola Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至自獵。

translations.literal: On wushen day he returned from the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day he returned from the hunt.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命林牙突呂不討烏古部。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Tolun, Master of the Hunt, was ordered to campaign against the Wugu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Tolun was sent to subdue the Wugu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On jisi day the Jurchen sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Jurchen presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，行瑟瑟禮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jimao day, the Seser rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao day, he performed the Seser rite.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，突呂不獻討烏古捷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingwei day, Tolun presented the triumph over the Wugu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingwei day, Tolun presented his victory over the Wugu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王都奏唐兵破定州，鐵剌死之，涅里袞、查剌等數十人被執。

translations.literal: On renzi day Wang Du reported that Tang troops had broken Dingzhou; Tieci died in the fight, and Nieli Gun, Chala, and several dozen others were taken prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Wang Du reported that Tang forces had stormed Dingzhou: Tieci had fallen, and Nieli Gun, Chala, and dozens of others were captured.

sentences.zh: 上以出師非時，甚悔之，厚賜戰歿將校之家。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the campaign had been ill-timed, deeply regretted it and lavishly rewarded the families of officers and men killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, judging the campaign mistimed, bitterly regretted it and heaped gifts upon the families of the fallen.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有事于太祖廟。

translations.literal: On gengwu day he performed rites at the Taizu temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he offered sacrifice at the Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，突厥來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingzi day, the Turks sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi day, the Turks sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔建應天皇太后誕聖碑于儀坤州。

translations.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered the erection of a birth-stele for Yingtian Grand Empress Dowager at Yikun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered a monument to the birth of Yingtian Grand Empress Dowager erected at Yikun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，突呂不遣人獻討烏古俘。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao day, Tolun dispatched men presenting Wugu captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao day, Tolun sent captives from the Wugu campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔分賜羣臣。

translations.literal: On guiwei day an edict ordered distribution of gifts among the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict distributed gifts among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸人皇王倍第。

translations.literal: On jichou day he visited the residence of the Human Sovereign King Bei.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day he called upon the Human Sovereign King Bei.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣人使唐。

translations.literal: On gengyin day envoys were sent to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he dispatched envoys to Tang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，再幸人皇王第。

translations.literal: On xinmao day he again visited the Human Sovereign King.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day he again called upon the Human Sovereign King.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，有司請以上生日為天授節，皇太后生日為永寧節。

translations.literal: On guisi day the relevant offices requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Heavenly Bestowal Festival and the Empress Dowager's birthday the Everlasting Peace Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day officials petitioned that the Emperor's birthday be observed as the Heavenly Bestowal Festival and the Empress Dowager's as the Everlasting Peace Festival.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，以永寧節，上率羣臣上壽於延和宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the guimao new moon, on the Everlasting Peace Festival the Emperor led the ministers to offer longevity felicitations at Yanhe Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the guimao new moon of the tenth month, at the Everlasting Peace Festival the Emperor led the court in offering birthday felicitations at Yanhe Palace.

sentences.zh: 己酉，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On jiyou day he visited the Taizu temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day he paid homage at the Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 唐遣使遺玉笛。

translations.literal: Tang sent envoys presenting a jade flute.
translations.idiomatic: Tang sent envoys bearing a jade flute as a gift.

sentences.zh: 甲子，天授節，上御五鸞殿受羣臣及諸國使賀。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the Heavenly Bestowal Festival, the Emperor presided in the Hall of Five Phoenixes receiving felicitations from ministers and envoys of various states.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Heavenly Bestowal Festival, the Emperor took his seat in the Hall of Five Phoenixes to receive felicitations from the court and foreign envoys.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, the Biegude sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, the Biegude sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，自將伐唐。

translations.literal: On xinchou day he personally led a campaign against Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he took the field in person against Tang.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，祭天地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guimao day, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao day, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，聞唐主復遣使來聘，上問左右，皆曰：「唐數遣使來，實畏威也。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, learning that the Tang ruler had again sent envoys on a diplomatic mission, the Emperor asked his attendants; all said: "Tang has repeatedly sent envoys; they truly fear our might.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, hearing that Tang had once more sent envoys, the Emperor asked his counselors. All replied: "Tang keeps sending envoys — they fear our power.

sentences.zh: 未可輕舉，觀釁而動可也。

translations.literal: One should not lightly undertake action; it is best to watch for an opening and then move.
translations.idiomatic: We should not strike rashly; let us watch for an opening and move when it comes.

sentences.zh: 」上然之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，次杏堝，唐使至，遂班師。

translations.literal: On jiayin day he halted at Xingguo; Tang envoys arrived, and he then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day he encamped at Apricot Ravine; when Tang envoys arrived, he turned the army homeward.

sentences.zh: 時人皇王在皇都，詔遣耶律羽之遷東丹民以實東平。

translations.literal: At that time the Human Sovereign King was at the imperial capital; an edict ordered Yelü Yuzhi to relocate Eastern Dan households to fill Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: The Human Sovereign King was then at the capital; an edict charged Yelü Yuzhi with resettling Eastern Dan households to populate Dongping.

sentences.zh: 其民或亡入新羅、女直，因詔困乏不能遷者，許上國富民給贍而隸屬之。

translations.literal: Some of those people fled into Silla and Jurchen lands; therefore an edict was issued that those too impoverished to move might be supported and placed under wealthy households of the upper realm.
translations.idiomatic: Some fled into Silla or Jurchen territory; an edict then permitted impoverished families unable to move to be supplied and placed under the care of wealthy households of the realm.

sentences.zh: 升東平郡為南京。

translations.literal: Dongping Commandery was elevated to Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping Commandery was raised to Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 天顯四年

translations.literal: Fourth Year of Tianxian
translations.idiomatic: Fourth Year of Tianxian

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬申朔，宴羣臣及諸國使，觀俳優角觝戲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on the renshen new moon in the first month of spring, he feasted ministers and envoys of various states and watched acrobats and wrestling performances.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, at the renshen new moon of the first spring month, he held a banquet for the court and foreign envoys and watched acrobats wrestle.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如瓜堝。

translations.literal: On jimao day he went to Guaguo.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he proceeded to Melon Ravine.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，閱遙輦氏戶籍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengxu day, he inspected the Yaolian clan household registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu day, he reviewed the household registers of the Yaolian line.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，望祀羣神。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiawu day, he performed distant sacrifice to the multitude of spirits.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiawu day, he offered distant sacrifice to the host of spirits.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，至自瓜堝。
