translations.literal: The seventh year of Tianxian
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of Tianxian

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬辰，征西將軍課里遣拽剌鐸括奏軍事。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, on renchen day in the first month, Western Campaign General Keli sent Zhaila Tuoguo to report on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year, on renchen day in the first month, Western Campaign General Keli sent Zhaila Tuoguo with a military report.

sentences.zh: 己亥，唐遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Tang dispatched envoys on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣人使唐。

translations.literal: On guimao day, envoys were dispatched to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he sent envoys to Tang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: On wushen day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，拽剌迪德使吳越還，吳越王遣使從，獻寶器。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renshen day, Zhaila Dide returned from a mission to Wuyue; the King of Wuyue sent envoys with him and presented precious vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen day, Zhaila Dide came back from Wuyue; the King of Wuyue sent envoys in his train and offered precious vessels.

sentences.zh: 復遣使持幣往報之。

translations.literal: Envoys were again dispatched bearing gifts to return the courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent envoys with gifts to answer the courtesy.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，林牙迪離畢指斥乘輿，囚之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jichou day, Linya Dilübi pointed at and reviled the imperial carriage and was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, Linya Dilübi cursed the imperial carriage to its face and was taken into custody.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣使諸國。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, envoys were dispatched to the various states.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he sent envoys to the various states.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上率羣臣朝于皇太后。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the Emperor led the assembled ministers in audience with the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day he led his ministers to attend the Empress Dowager at court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，唐遣使來聘，致人皇王倍書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day jiaxu, Tang sent envoys on a friendly visit, bearing a letter from Renhuang Prince Bei.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiaxu day, Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission, carrying a letter from Renhuang Prince Bei.

sentences.zh: 己卯，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，幸祖州，謁太祖陵。

translations.literal: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month, he went to Zuzhou and paid respects at Emperor Taizu's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month he traveled to Zuzhou and visited Emperor Taizu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，御製太祖建國碑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day wuchen, he personally composed the inscription for Emperor Taizu's Founding of the State stele.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, he composed in his own hand the text for the stele commemorating Emperor Taizu's founding of the state.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，烏古、敵烈德來貢。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Wugu and Dielie tribes came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Wugu and Dielie came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，觀角觝戲。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, he watched sumo wrestling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day he watched sumo bouts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，賜中外官吏物有差。

translations.literal: On the xinsi new moon of the seventh month of autumn, gifts were distributed to officials within and without the court, each in due measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the seventh autumn month, officials inside and outside the court received gifts in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜高年布帛。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, cloth and silk were granted to the aged.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day cloth and silk were bestowed on the elderly.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召羣臣耆老議政。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, he summoned ministers and elders to discuss state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day he called ministers and elders together to discuss government.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，唐遣使遺紅牙笙。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Tang sent envoys presenting a red-tooth bamboo flute.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Tang sent envoys bearing a red-tooth bamboo flute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，使復至，懼報定州之役也。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the envoys came again, fearing retaliation for the campaign at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the envoys returned, anxious over how to answer for the affair at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，唐盧龍軍節度使趙德鈞遣人進時果。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Zhao Dejun, military governor of Tang's Lulong Army, sent men presenting seasonal fruits.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Zhao Dejun, Tang's governor of the Lulong Army, sent men with seasonal fruits.

sentences.zh: 丁未，薦新于太祖廟。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the new grain harvest was offered at Emperor Taizu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the first fruits of the harvest were offered at Emperor Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，捕鵝于沿柳湖，風雨暴至，舟覆，溺死者六十餘人，命存恤其家，識以為戒。

translations.literal: On day renxu in the eighth month, geese were being caught at Lake Yanliu when a violent storm suddenly arrived; boats capsized and more than sixty drowned. He ordered their families cared for and took the event as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the eighth month, while geese were being taken on Lake Yanliu, a sudden tempest struck; boats overturned and more than sixty men drowned. He ordered their families relieved and marked the disaster as a warning.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，林牙迪離畢逸囚，復獲而鞫之，知其事本誣構，釋之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Linya Dilbi escaped custody; recaptured and interrogated, it was learned the matter had been a false accusation, and he was released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Linya Dilbi broke free; seized again and questioned, it turned out the whole affair had been a frame-up, and he was set free.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On day gengzi in the ninth month, the Zubu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month the Zubu brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，唐遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day yimao, Tang sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on yimao day, Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣使雲中。

translations.literal: On day jisi, envoys were dispatched to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day envoys were sent to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，遣使存問獲里國。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day dinghai, envoys were sent to convey greetings to the Huoli kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dinghai day, envoys were dispatched to inquire after the Huoli kingdom.

sentences.zh: 丁未，阻卜貢海東青鶻三十連。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Zubu presented thirty strings of Eastern Sea green goshawks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Zubu presented thirty strings of Eastern Sea green goshawks.

sentences.zh: 十二月亥辛，以叛人泥離袞家口分賜羣臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day xinhai, the households of the rebel Nili Gun were divided up and bestowed on the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinhai day, the families of the rebel Nili Gun were divided among the ministers as gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，西狩，駐蹕平地松林。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, he went west to hunt and halted at Pingdi Songlin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day he hunted westward and encamped at Pingdi Pine Forest.

sentences.zh: 天顯八年

translations.literal: The eighth year of Tianxian.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth year of Tianxian.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月戊子，女直來貢。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the eighth year, on day wuzi, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, in the first spring month, on wuzi day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命皇太弟李胡、左威衞上將軍撒割率兵伐党項。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the imperial younger brother Li Hu and Left Weiwu Guard senior general Sagie were ordered to lead troops against the Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial younger brother Li Hu and Sagie, senior general of the Left Weiwu Guard, were ordered to march against the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上親餞之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor personally saw them off with a farewell feast.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Emperor personally saw them off with a farewell feast.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，吐谷渾、阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On day xinhai in the second month, the Tuyuhun and Zubu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the second month the Tuyuhun and Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，剋實魯使唐還，以附獻物分賜羣臣。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Kelu, envoy to Tang, returned; the tribute gifts he brought were divided among the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Kelu, envoy to Tang, came back; the gifts he had brought were divided among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，皇太弟討党項勝還，宴勞之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao in the third month, the imperial younger brother returned victorious from campaigning against the Tangut; a feast was held to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the third month the imperial younger brother returned victorious from the Tangut campaign, and a feast was held to honor him.

sentences.zh: 丙申，唐遣使請罷征党項兵，上以戰捷及党項巳聽命報之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Tang sent envoys requesting that the campaign against the Tangut be halted; the Emperor replied that the battle had been won and the Tangut had already submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Tang sent envoys asking that the Tangut campaign be stopped; the Emperor answered that the war was already won and the Tangut had submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，党項來貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day wuwu, the Tangut came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on wuwu day, the Tangut brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，獵獨牛山，惕隱迪輦所乘內廐騮馬斃，因賜名其山曰騮山。

translations.literal: On day jichou in the fifth month, he hunted at Mount Duniu; the imperial stud chestnut horse ridden by Tiyin Dielian died, and the mountain was accordingly named Mount Liu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the fifth month he hunted at Mount Duniu; the chestnut stallion from the inner stud that Tiyin Dielian was riding died, and the mountain was named Mount Liu in its honor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，如沿柳湖。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, he went to Lake Yanliu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he went to Lake Yanliu.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On day jiayin in the sixth month, the Zubu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the sixth month the Zubu brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，回鶻阿薩蘭來貢。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Uighur chieftain Aslan came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Uighur chieftain Aslan came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，行納后禮。

translations.literal: On day wuyin in the seventh month of autumn, the empress-installation ceremony was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the seventh autumn month the empress-installation rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇子提離古生。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the prince Tiligu was born.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince Tiligu was born.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鐵驪、女直、阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Iron Li, Jurchen, and Zubu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Iron Li, Jurchen, and Zubu all brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day yisi, the Zubu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on yisi day, the Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至自沿柳湖。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, he returned from Lake Yanliu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he returned from Lake Yanliu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，唐遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Tang sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣拔剌使唐。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Bala was dispatched as envoy to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Bala was sent as envoy to Tang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，烏古吐魯沒來貢。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Wugu chieftain Tulunmo came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Wugu chieftain Tulunmo came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，太皇太后崩，遣使告哀于唐及人皇王倍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou in the eleventh month, the Grand Empress Dowager died; envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Tang and to Renhuang Prince Bei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eleventh month the Grand Empress Dowager died; envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Tang and to Renhuang Prince Bei.

sentences.zh: 是月，唐主嗣源殂，子從厚立。

translations.literal: That month, Tang's emperor Siyuan died; his son Conghou succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Tang's emperor Siyuan died, and his son Conghou took the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，党項來貢。

translations.literal: On day dingmao in the twelfth month, the Tangut came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the twelfth month the Tangut brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 天顯九年

translations.literal: The ninth year of Tianxian.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth year of Tianxian.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月癸酉，漁于土河。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the ninth year, on day guiyou, he fished on the Tu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first spring month, on guiyou day, he fished on the Tu River.

sentences.zh: 丙申，党項貢駝、鹿。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Tangut presented camels and deer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Tangut presented camels and deer.

sentences.zh: 己亥，南京進白麞。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Nanjing presented a white roe deer.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Nanjing presented a white roe deer.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊午，唐遣使告哀，即日遣使弔祭。

translations.literal: On day wuwu in the intercalary month, Tang sent envoys announcing mourning; the same day envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the intercalary month Tang sent envoys announcing mourning, and that same day envoys were sent out to offer condolences and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，東幸。

translations.literal: On day renxu, he proceeded east on tour.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day he set out on an eastern tour.

sentences.zh: 女直來貢。

translations.literal: The Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: On day renshen in the second month, he offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the second month he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，葬太皇太后於德陵。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Deling tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Deling.

sentences.zh: 前二日，發喪于菆塗殿，上具衰服以送。

translations.literal: Two days earlier, the funeral procession departed from the Cao Tu Hall; the Emperor wore mourning garb to escort her.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before, the funeral cortege had set out from the Cao Tu Hall, and the Emperor went in full mourning to see her off.

sentences.zh: 後追諡宣簡皇后，詔建碑于陵。

translations.literal: Later she was posthumously honored as Empress Xuanjian; an edict ordered a stele erected at the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Later she was given the posthumous title Empress Xuanjian, and an edict ordered a stele raised at the tomb.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day guimao in the third month, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the third month the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，唐李從珂弒其主自立。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Li Congke of Tang killed his sovereign and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, Li Congke of Tang murdered his lord and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 人皇王倍自唐上書請討。

translations.literal: Renhuang Prince Bei sent a letter from Tang requesting permission to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: From Tang, Renhuang Prince Bei sent a letter asking leave to march against him.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，如沿柳湖。

translations.literal: On day jiachen in the fifth month, he went to Lake Yanliu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the fifth month he went to Lake Yanliu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 大星晝隕。

translations.literal: A great star fell during daylight.
translations.idiomatic: A great star fell in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳朔，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: On the jisi new moon in the sixth month, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the sixth month the Biegude came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，唐李從厚謝弔祭所遣使初至闕。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the envoys sent by Tang's Li Conghou to thank him for the condolence mission first arrived at court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the envoys Li Conghou of Tang had sent to thank the court for its condolence mission first arrived at the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬午，自將南伐。

translations.literal: On day renwu in the eighth month of autumn, he personally led a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the eighth autumn month he took the field in person on a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，拽剌解里手接飛雁，上異之，因以祭天地。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Zhaila Jieli caught a flying goose in his hand; the Emperor marveled at it and used it in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Zhaila Jieli caught a flying goose in his bare hand; the Emperor took it for a marvel and offered it in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，酉南星隕如雨。

translations.literal: On day gengzi in the ninth month, stars fell like rain in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month stars rained down in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次雲州。

translations.literal: On day yimao, he halted at Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he encamped at Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，拔河陰。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Heyin was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Heyin was captured.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，略地靈丘，父老進牛酒犒師。

translations.literal: On day dinghai in the tenth month of winter, he overran Lingqiu; local elders brought cattle and wine to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on dinghai day in the tenth month, he overran Lingqiu, and local elders brought cattle and wine to feast the army.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，圍武州之陽城。

translations.literal: On day xinchou in the eleventh month, he besieged Yangcheng in Wu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eleventh month he besieged Yangcheng in Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陽城降。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Yangcheng surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Yangcheng surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，洼只城降，括所俘丁壯籍于軍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Wazhi City surrendered; able-bodied men among the captives were registered for military service.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Wazhi City surrendered; able-bodied men among the captives were enrolled in the army.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，皇子阿鉢撒葛里生，皇后不豫。

translations.literal: On day renchen in the twelfth month, the prince Abo Sageli was born; the Empress fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the twelfth month Prince Abo Sageli was born, and the Empress fell ill.

sentences.zh: 是月駐蹕百湖之西南。

translations.literal: That month he halted southwest of Baihu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: That month he encamped southwest of Baihu Lake.

sentences.zh: 天顯十年

translations.literal: The tenth year of Tianxian.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth year of Tianxian.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月戊申，皇后崩于行在。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the tenth year, on day wushen, the Empress died at the temporary palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the first spring month, on wushen day, the Empress died at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，百僚請加追諡，不許。

translations.literal: On day wuyin in the second month, the officials requested a posthumous title be added; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the second month the officials asked that a posthumous title be added, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宰相涅里袞謀南奔，事覺，執之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Chancellor Nieli Gun plotted to flee south; the affair was discovered and he was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Chancellor Nieli Gun plotted to flee south; the plot came to light and he was seized.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，党項來貢。

translations.literal: On day wuwu in the third month, the Tangut came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the third month the Tangut brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，吐谷渾酋長退欲德率眾內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Tuyuhun chieftain Tuiyude led his people in submitting to Liao rule.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, the Tuyuhun chieftain Tuiyude led his people in submitting to the court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，皇太后父族及母前夫之族二帳並為國舅，以蕭緬思為尚父領之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, two clans — the Empress Dowager's father's kin and the clan of her mother's former husband — were both made imperial uncles-in-law; Xiao Miansi was appointed Shangfu to head them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day two clans — the Empress Dowager's father's line and the clan of her mother's former husband — were both made imperial uncles-in-law, with Xiao Miansi appointed Shangfu to lead them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，錄囚。

translations.literal: On day jichou, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，始製服行后喪。

translations.literal: On the jiawu new moon of the fifth month, he first donned mourning garb and observed the empress's funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the fifth month he first put on mourning dress and began the empress's funeral observances.

sentences.zh: 丙午，葬于奉陵。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, she was buried at Fengling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day she was buried at Fengling.

sentences.zh: 上自製文，諡曰彰德皇后。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally composed the epitaph; she was posthumously titled Empress of Manifest Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote the epitaph himself; she was posthumously styled Empress of Manifest Virtue.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以舍利王庭鶚為龍化州節度使。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Shili Wang Ting'e was appointed military governor of Longhua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Shili Wang Ting'e was made military governor of Longhua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，吐渾來貢。

translations.literal: On day yichou in the sixth month, the Tuhun came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the sixth month the Tuhun came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸品不里淀。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, he visited Pinbuli Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day he visited Pinbuli Marsh.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，獵南赤山。

translations.literal: On day yimao in the seventh month of autumn, he hunted at South Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the seventh autumn month he hunted at South Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙午，幸弘福寺為皇后飯僧，見觀音畫像，乃大聖皇帝、應天皇后及人皇王所施，顧左右曰：「昔與父母兄弟聚觀于此，歲時未幾，今我獨來！

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day bingwu, he visited Hongfu Temple to feed monks on the Empress's behalf; seeing a painted image of Guanyin donated by the Great Sage Emperor, Empress Yingtian, and Renhuang Prince, he turned to those beside him and said, "In years not long past I gathered here with my parents and brothers to view this; now I come alone!
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, on bingwu day, he went to Hongfu Temple to feed monks for the Empress's sake; there he saw a painted image of Guanyin that the Great Sage Emperor, Empress Yingtian, and Renhuang Prince had donated. Turning to those beside him he said, "Not so many years ago my parents, my brothers, and I stood here together to look at this — and now I come alone!

sentences.zh: 」悲嘆不已。

translations.literal: " He mourned and sighed without end.
translations.idiomatic: " He wept and sighed without end.

sentences.zh: 乃自製文題于壁，以極追感之意。

translations.literal: He then personally composed an inscription for the wall, giving fullest voice to his grief and longing.
translations.idiomatic: Then he composed an inscription in his own hand and had it written on the wall, giving full expression to his grief.

sentences.zh: 讀者悲之。

translations.literal: Those who read it were moved to sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: All who read it were moved to tears.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，如金瓶濼，遣拽剌化哥、窟魯里、阿魯掃姑等捉生敵境。

translations.literal: On day gengchen in the twelfth month, he went to Jinping Marsh and dispatched Zhaila Huage, Kululi, Arusuogu, and others to capture livestock in enemy territory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the twelfth month he went to Jinping Marsh and sent Zhaila Huage, Kululi, Arusuogu, and others to raid enemy lands for livestock.

sentences.zh: 天顯十一年

translations.literal: The eleventh year of Tianxian.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh year of Tianxian.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，鈎魚于土河。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year, he went ice fishing on the Tu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, in the first spring month, he went ice fishing on the Tu River.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如潢河。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, he went to the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he went to the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅朔，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On the gengyin new moon of the third month, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the third month the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，謁祖陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day gengshen, he visited the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on gengshen day, he paid homage at the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，還都，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, he returned to the capital and visited Emperor Taizu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day he returned to the capital and visited Emperor Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，燕民之復業者陳汴州事宜。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yan subjects who had resumed their livelihoods reported affairs at Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Yan people who had returned to their occupations reported on conditions at Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，女直諸部來貢。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Jurchen tribes came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Jurchen tribes brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜回鶻使衣有差。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Uighur envoys were granted clothing in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Uighur envoys were given robes in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，清暑沿柳湖。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day wuxu, he took the summer retreat along Lake Yanliu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu day, he passed the summer at Lake Yanliu.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: On the wuwu new moon of the sixth month, the Bigide came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the sixth month the Bigide came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，吐谷渾來貢。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Tuyuhun came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Tuyuhun brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，烏古來貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day xinmao, the Ugu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the seventh autumn month the Ugu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，蒲割?公主率三河烏古來朝。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Princess Puge(?) led the Sanhe Ugu to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Princess Puge(?) led the Sanhe Ugu to court.

sentences.zh: 丙申，唐河東節度使石敬瑭為其主所討，遣趙瑩因西南路招討盧不姑求救，上白太后曰：「李從珂弒君自立，神人共怒，宜行天討。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Shi Jingtang, Tang's military governor of Hedong, was attacked by his sovereign and sent Zhao Ying through Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Lu Bugu to beg for aid; the Emperor reported to the Empress Dowager, saying, "Li Congke murdered his lord and installed himself — gods and men alike are enraged; heaven's punishment should be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Shi Jingtang, Tang's governor of Hedong, was attacked by his sovereign and sent Zhao Ying through the Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Lu Bugu to plead for help. The Emperor told the Empress Dowager, "Li Congke murdered his lord and seized the throne — heaven and earth are both enraged; he deserves heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 」時趙德鈞亦遣使至，河東復遣桑維翰來告急，遂許興師。

translations.literal: " At that time Zhao Dejun also sent envoys, and Hedong again sent Sang Weihan in urgent appeal; troops were accordingly authorized.
translations.idiomatic: " At the same time Zhao Dejun sent envoys as well, and Hedong dispatched Sang Weihan again in desperate appeal; the court agreed to raise an army.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，遣蕭轄里報河東師期。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day jiwei, Xiao Gelili was dispatched to report the campaign schedule to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei day, Xiao Gelili was sent to notify Hedong of the army's timetable.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吐谷渾來貢。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Tuyuhun came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Tuyuhun brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，自將以援敬瑭。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, he personally led troops to relieve Jingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he personally took the field to rescue Jingtang.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，有飛頳自墜而死，南府夷離菫曷魯恩得之以獻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day guisi, a flying scarlet bird fell from the sky dead; Yilizhen Halu En of the Southern Prefecture obtained it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi day, a scarlet bird fell dead from the sky; Yilizhen Halu En of the Southern Prefecture found it and presented it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 卜之，吉。

translations.literal: Divination was performed — auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When divination was performed, the omen was auspicious.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此從珂自滅之兆也！

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "This is a sign that Congke will destroy himself!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is a sign that Congke will bring about his own ruin!

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，入雁門。

translations.literal: " On day dingyou, he entered Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingyou day he entered Yanmen Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，次忻州，祀天地。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, he halted at Xinzhou and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he encamped at Xinzhou and offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次太原。

translations.literal: On day jihai, he halted at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day he encamped at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣使諭敬瑭曰：「朕興師遠來，當即與卿破賊。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, he sent envoys to tell Jingtang, "I have raised an army and come from afar; I shall at once join you in breaking the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day he sent envoys to tell Jingtang, "I have marched three thousand li to reach you; I will join you at once in crushing the enemy.

sentences.zh: 」會唐將高行周、符彥卿以兵來拒，遂勒兵陳于太原。

translations.literal: " Tang generals Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing came with troops to resist, so he drew up his army in battle order before Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: " Tang generals Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing advanced to oppose him, and he drew up his army in battle order before Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 及戰，佯為之却。

translations.literal: When battle was joined, he feigned retreat.
translations.idiomatic: When battle was joined, he feigned a retreat.

sentences.zh: 唐將張敬達、楊光遠又陣于西，未成列，以兵薄之。

translations.literal: Tang generals Zhang Jingda and Yang Guangyuan also formed battle lines to the west; before their ranks were complete, he pressed them with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Tang generals Zhang Jingda and Yang Guangyuan also drew up to the west; before their lines were fully formed, he pressed them hard.

sentences.zh: 而行周、彥卿為伏兵所斷，首尾不相救。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Xingzhou and Yanqing were cut off by ambush troops and could not rescue one another, head and tail alike.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Xingzhou and Yanqing were cut off by hidden troops and could not aid each other — head and tail alike were stranded.

sentences.zh: 敬達、光遠大敗，棄仗如山，斬首數萬級。

translations.literal: Jingda and Guangyuan were utterly defeated; discarded weapons piled like hills, and tens of thousands of heads were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Jingda and Guangyuan were routed utterly; discarded weapons piled like hills, and tens of thousands of heads were taken.

sentences.zh: 敬達走保晉安寨，夷離菫的魯與戰，死之。

translations.literal: Jingda fled to hold Jin'an Stockade; Yilizhen Dilu fought him and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Jingda fled to hold Jin'an Stockade; Yilizhen Dilu fought him and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭率官屬來見，上執手撫慰之。

translations.literal: Jingtang led his officials to an audience; the Emperor took his hand and comforted him.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang came with his officials to pay homage; the Emperor took his hand and comforted him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，圍晉安。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jin'an was besieged.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Jin'an was besieged.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以的魯子徒離骨嗣為夷離菫，仍以父字為名，以旌其忠。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Dilu's son Tuli Gu succeeded as yilizhen, taking his father's style as his name to honor his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Dilu's son Tuli Gu succeeded as yilizhen, taking his father's style as his own name to honor his loyalty.

sentences.zh: 南宰相鶻離底、奚監軍寅你已、將軍陪阿臨陣退懦，上召切責之。

translations.literal: Southern Chancellor Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A had shown cowardice and retreated in battle; the Emperor summoned and sharply rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Chancellor Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A had quailed and fallen back in battle; the Emperor summoned them and rebuked them sharply.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，封敬瑭為晉王，幸其府。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day jiazi, Jingtang was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, and the Emperor visited his residence.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jiazi day, Jingtang was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, and the Emperor visited his residence.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭與妻李率其親屬捧觴上壽。

translations.literal: Jingtang and his wife, the Lady Li, led their kin in raising cups to wish him long life.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang and his wife Lady Li led their kin in raising cups to wish the Emperor long life.

sentences.zh: 初圍晉安，分遣精兵守其要害，以絕援兵之路。

translations.literal: When the siege of Jin'an first began, picked troops were dispatched to hold key points and cut off the routes of relief armies.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege of Jin'an began, picked troops were posted at key points to cut off every route by which relief might arrive.

sentences.zh: 而李從珂遣趙延壽以兵二萬屯團栢谷，范延廣以兵二萬屯遼州，范延廣以兵二萬屯遼州 延廣，新五代史五一本傳作延光。

translations.literal: Li Congke sent Zhao Yanshou with twenty thousand troops to encamp at Tuanbai Valley, and Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand troops to encamp at Liaozhou; Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand troops to encamp at Liaozhou — Yanguang: in the biographical chapter of the New History of the Five Dynasties, fascicle 51, this name is written Yanguang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congke sent Zhao Yanshou with twenty thousand men to hold Tuanbai Valley and Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand to hold Liaozhou; Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand to hold Liaozhou — Yanguang: in the biographical chapter of the New History of the Five Dynasties, fascicle 51, the name is written Yanguang.

sentences.zh: 此避太宗德光名改。

translations.literal: This was changed to avoid the taboo name of Taizong, Deguang.
translations.idiomatic: The text was altered here to avoid the taboo name of Taizong, Deguang.

sentences.zh: 幽州趙德鈞以所部兵萬餘由上黨趨延壽軍，合勢進擊。

translations.literal: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou, with more than ten thousand troops under his command, came from Shangdang toward Yanshou's army to join forces and attack.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou, with more than ten thousand men under his command, marched from Shangdang toward Yanshou's army to combine forces and strike.

sentences.zh: 知此有備，皆逗留不進。

translations.literal: Learning that preparations had been made here, all halted and would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that the enemy was prepared, they all halted and would not advance.

sentences.zh: 從珂遂將精騎三萬出次河陽，親督諸軍。

translations.literal: Congke then led thirty thousand picked cavalry out and encamped at Heyang, personally directing the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Congke then led thirty thousand picked cavalry out and encamped at Heyang, personally directing the armies.

sentences.zh: 然知其不救，但日酣飲悲歌而己。

translations.literal: Yet knowing no rescue would come, he only drank deeply and sang mournful songs each day.
translations.idiomatic: Yet knowing no rescue would come, he spent his days drinking deep and singing dirges.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召敬瑭至行在所，賜坐。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Jingtang was summoned to the imperial camp and granted a seat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Jingtang was summoned to the imperial camp and given a seat.

sentences.zh: 上從容語之曰：「吾三千里舉兵而來，一戰而勝，殆天意也。

translations.literal: The Emperor spoke to him at ease, saying, "I raised an army and came three thousand li; one battle and victory — surely this is heaven's will.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor spoke to him at ease: "I raised an army and marched three thousand li; one battle and we were victorious — surely this is heaven's will.

sentences.zh: 觀汝雄偉弘大，宜受茲南土，世為我藩輔。

translations.literal: Seeing your imposing stature and great capacity, you should receive these southern lands and for generations serve as my frontier vassal and support.
translations.idiomatic: You look imposing and broad in capacity; you should receive these southern lands and for generations serve as my frontier vassal and support.

sentences.zh: 」遂命有司設壇晉陽，備禮冊命。

translations.literal: " He then ordered the officials to set up an altar at Jinyang and prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: " He then ordered officials to set up an altar at Jinyang and prepare the rites of investiture.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，冊敬瑭為大晉皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day dingyou, Jingtang was invested as Emperor of Great Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingyou day, Jingtang was invested as Emperor of Great Jin.

sentences.zh: 自戊戌至戊申，候騎兩奏南有兵至，復奏西有兵至。

translations.literal: From day wuxu to day wushen, outriders twice reported troops arriving from the south, then again reported troops arriving from the west.
translations.idiomatic: From wuxu day to wushen day, outriders twice reported troops approaching from the south, then again reported troops approaching from the west.

sentences.zh: 復奏西有兵至 奏，原作「於」。

translations.literal: Again they reported troops arriving from the west — zou (report): the original text read yu (at).
translations.idiomatic: Again they reported troops approaching from the west — zou (report): the original text read yu (at).

sentences.zh: 據永樂大典

translations.literal: According to the Yongle Encyclopedia
translations.idiomatic: According to the Yongle Encyclopedia

sentences.zh: (以下稱大典)〉

translations.literal: (hereafter abbreviated as the Encyclopedia)〉
translations.idiomatic: (hereafter abbreviated as the Encyclopedia)〉

sentences.zh: 四八 ○改。

translations.literal: 480, emended.
translations.idiomatic: 480, emended.

sentences.zh: 命惕隱迪輦洼拒之。

translations.literal: Tiyin Dielian Wa was ordered to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: Tiyin Dielian Wa was ordered to repel them.

sentences.zh: 唐將張敬達在圍八十餘日，內外隔絕，軍儲殆盡，至濯馬糞、屑木以飼馬，馬饑至自相啖其騣尾，死則以充食。

translations.literal: Tang general Zhang Jingda, besieged for more than eighty days, was cut off within and without; army stores were nearly exhausted, so that horse dung was washed and splintered wood fed to the horses; the horses grew so hungry they ate one another's manes and tails, and when they died their flesh was eaten.
translations.idiomatic: Tang general Zhang Jingda, besieged for more than eighty days, was cut off within and without; army stores were nearly exhausted. They washed horse dung and fed the horses splintered wood; the horses grew so hungry they ate one another's manes and tails, and when they died their flesh was eaten.

sentences.zh: 光遠等勸敬達出降，敬達曰：「吾有死而已。

translations.literal: Guangyuan and the others urged Jingda to surrender; Jingda said, "I have only death.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan and the others urged Jingda to surrender; Jingda said, "I have only death.

sentences.zh: 爾欲降，寧斬吾首以降。」

translations.literal: If you wish to surrender, you may cut off my head and surrender with it."
translations.idiomatic: If you wish to surrender, cut off my head and surrender with it."

sentences.zh: 閏月甲子，楊光遠、安審琦殺敬達以降。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on day jiazi, Yang Guangyuan and An Shenqi killed Jingda and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiazi day, Yang Guangyuan and An Shenqi killed Jingda and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 上聞敬達至死不變，謂左右曰：「凡為人臣，當如此也！

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard that Jingda had remained steadfast unto death, he said to those beside him, "Every subject should be like this!
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor learned that Jingda had remained steadfast unto death, he said to those beside him, "Every loyal subject should be like this!

sentences.zh: 」命以禮葬。

translations.literal: " He ordered him buried with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered him buried with full rites.

sentences.zh: 所降軍士及馬五千匹以賜晉帝。

translations.literal: The surrendered soldiers and five thousand horses were bestowed on the Jin Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered soldiers and five thousand horses were bestowed on the Jin Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，祀天地以告成功。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to in announcement of success.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day sacrifice was offered to Heaven and Earth to announce success.

sentences.zh: 庚午，僕射蕭酷古只奏趙德鈞等諸援兵將遁，詔夜發兵追擊。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Vice Chancellor Xiao Kuguzhi reported that Zhao Dejun and the other relief armies were about to flee; an edict ordered troops sent out by night in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Vice Chancellor Xiao Kuguzhi reported that Zhao Dejun and the other relief armies were about to flee; an edict ordered troops sent out by night in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 德鈞等軍皆投戈棄甲，自相蹂踐，擠于川谷者不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Dejun's army and the others all cast aside weapons and armor, trampling one another; those crushed into ravines and valleys were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Dejun's army and the others cast aside weapons and armor and trampled one another; those crushed into ravines and valleys were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 仍命皇太子馳輕騎據險要，追及步兵萬餘，悉降之。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince was further ordered to ride light cavalry to seize strategic points; more than ten thousand foot soldiers were overtaken and all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince was further ordered to ride light cavalry to seize the strategic passes; more than ten thousand foot soldiers were overtaken and all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛未，兵度團柏谷，以酒肴祀天地。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the army crossed Tuanbai Valley and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the army crossed Tuanbai Valley and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and food.

sentences.zh: 俄追及德鈞父子，乃率眾降。

translations.literal: Soon Dejun and his son were overtaken, and they led their followers in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Dejun and his son were overtaken, and they led their followers in surrender.

sentences.zh: 次潞州，召諸將議，皆請班師，從之。

translations.literal: Halting at Luzhou, he summoned the generals to counsel; all asked to withdraw the army, and he agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Halting at Luzhou, he summoned the generals to counsel; all urged withdrawal, and he agreed.

sentences.zh: 命南宰相解領、鶻離底、奚監軍寅你已、將軍陪阿先還。

translations.literal: Southern Chancellor Jieling, Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A were ordered to return first.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Chancellor Jieling, Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A were ordered to return first.

sentences.zh: 壬申，惕隱洼、林牙迪離畢來獻俘。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Tiyin Wa and Linya Dilbi came to present captives.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Tiyin Wa and Linya Dilbi came to present captives.

sentences.zh: 晉帝辭歸，上與宴飲。

translations.literal: The Jin Emperor took leave to return; the Emperor feasted and drank with him.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Emperor took leave to return; the Emperor feasted and drank with him.

sentences.zh: 酒酣，執手約為父子。

translations.literal: When the wine had gone deep, they clasped hands and pledged themselves as father and son.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine had gone deep, they clasped hands and pledged themselves as father and son.

sentences.zh: 以白貂裘一、廐馬二十、戰馬千二百餞之。

translations.literal: One white sable cloak, twenty stud horses, and twelve hundred war horses were given as a farewell gift.
translations.idiomatic: He gave one white sable cloak, twenty stud horses, and twelve hundred war horses as a farewell gift.

sentences.zh: 命迪離畢將五千騎送入洛。

translations.literal: Dilbi was ordered to lead five thousand cavalry to escort him into Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Dilbi was ordered to lead five thousand cavalry to escort him into Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 臨別，謂之曰：「朕留此，候亂定乃還耳。

translations.literal: At parting he said to him, "I remain here until the turmoil is settled, and then I shall return.
translations.idiomatic: At parting he said to him, "I remain here until the turmoil is settled, and then I shall return.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，晉帝至河陽，李從珂窮蹙，召人皇王倍同死，不從，遣人殺之，乃舉族自焚。

translations.literal: " On day xinsi, the Jin Emperor reached Heyang; Li Congke, in desperate straits, summoned Renhuang Prince Bei to die with him; Bei refused, so he sent men to kill him, then the whole clan burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi day the Jin Emperor reached Heyang. Li Congke, in desperate straits, summoned Renhuang Prince Bei to die with him; Bei refused, so Congke sent men to kill him, then the whole clan burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 詔收其士卒戰歿者瘞之汾水上，以京觀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the collection and burial on the Fen River of his soldiers who had fallen in battle, as a victory mound.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the soldiers who had fallen in battle collected and buried on the Fen River as a victory mound.

sentences.zh: 晉命桑維翰為文，紀上功德。

translations.literal: Jin ordered Sang Weihan to compose a text recording the Emperor's merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Jin ordered Sang Weihan to compose a text recording the Emperor's merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉朔，遣近侍撻魯存問晉帝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou new moon, the personal attendant Talu was dispatched to inquire after the Jin Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou new moon, the personal attendant Talu was sent to inquire after the Jin Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以晉安所獲分賜將校。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the spoils taken at Jin'an were divided and bestowed on officers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the spoils taken at Jin'an were divided and bestowed on officers.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣使馳奏皇太后，及報諸道師還。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, envoys were dispatched at speed to report to the Empress Dowager and to notify every circuit that the army was returning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day envoys were dispatched at speed to report to the Empress Dowager and to notify every circuit that the army was returning.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，發太原。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, he set out from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he set out from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，聞晉帝入洛，遣郎君解里德撫問。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, learning that the Jin Emperor had entered Luoyang, he dispatched Langjun Jielide to convey greetings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, learning that the Jin Emperor had entered Luoyang, he dispatched Langjun Jielide to convey greetings.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次細河，閱降將趙德鈞父子兵馬。

translations.literal: On day renchen, he halted at Xihe and reviewed the troops and horses of the surrendered generals Zhao Dejun and his son.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day he halted at Xihe and reviewed the troops and horses of the surrendered generals Zhao Dejun and his son.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，次雁門，以沙太保所部兵分隸諸將。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, he halted at Yanmen and distributed the troops under Grand Guardian Sha among the various generals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he halted at Yanmen and distributed the troops under Grand Guardian Sha among the various generals.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸應州。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, he visited Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he visited Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，唐大同、彰國、振武三節度使迎見，留之不遣。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the military governors of Tang's Datong, Zhangguo, and Zhenwu circuits came to an audience; they were detained and not sent away.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the military governors of Tang's Datong, Zhangguo, and Zhenwu circuits came to an audience; they were detained and not sent away.

sentences.zh: 天顯十二年

translations.literal: The twelfth year of Tianxian.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year of Tianxian.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月丙辰，次堆子口。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the twelfth year, on day bingchen, he halted at Duizikou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the first spring month, on bingchen day, he halted at Duizikou.

sentences.zh: 唐大同軍節度判官吳巒閉城拒命，遣崔廷勳圍其城。

translations.literal: Wu Luan, adjutant of Tang's Datong Army, closed the city and refused orders; Cui Tingxun was dispatched to besiege the city.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Luan, adjutant of Tang's Datong Army, closed the city and refused orders; Cui Tingxun was dispatched to besiege the city.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上親征，至城下諭之，巒降。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor personally campaigned, reached beneath the walls and instructed them; Luan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor personally took the field, reached the foot of the walls and instructed them; Luan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，射鬼箭于雲州北。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, demon-arrows were shot north of Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day demon-arrows were shot north of Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，祀天地。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day sacrifice was offered to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣國舅安端發奚西部民各還本土。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the imperial uncle An Duan was dispatched to send the people of the western Xi tribes each back to their native lands.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the imperial uncle An Duan was dispatched to send the people of the western Xi tribes each back to their native lands.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇太后遣侍衞實魯趣行，是夕，率輕騎先進。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Empress Dowager dispatched the attendant Shilu to urge him onward; that evening he led light cavalry forward in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Empress Dowager dispatched the attendant Shilu to urge him onward; that evening he led light cavalry forward in advance.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，皇子述律迎謁于灤河，告功太祖行宮。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Prince Shulü came to meet him at the Luan River and reported his victory at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Shulü came to meet him at the Luan River and reported his victory at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，朝于皇太后，進珍玩為壽。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, he attended court before the Empress Dowager and presented precious objects to wish her long life.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day he attended court before the Empress Dowager and presented precious objects to wish her long life.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，以軍前所獲俘叛入幽州者皆斬之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day dinghai, captives taken before the army who had rebelled and entered Youzhou were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, captives taken before the army who had rebelled and entered Youzhou were all executed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔諸部休養士卒。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an edict ordered every tribe to rest and restore its soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered every tribe to rest and restore its soldiers.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，晉遣唐所掠郎君剌哥、文班吏蕭岱里還朝。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jin returned Langjun Lage and Secretariat clerk Xiao Daili, whom Tang had seized.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Jin returned Langjun Lage and Secretariat clerk Xiao Daili, whom Tang had seized.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，晉遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day gengshen, Jin sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen day, Jin sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，晉天雄軍節度使范延廣潛遣人請內附，不納。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Fan Yanguang, Jin's military governor of the Tianxiong Army, secretly sent men asking to defect; they were not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Fan Yanguang, Jin's governor of the Tianxiong Army, secretly sent men offering to defect; the court refused them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣郎君的烈古、梅里迭烈使晉。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Langjun Dieligu and Meili Dielie were dispatched as envoys to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Langjun Dieligu and Meili Dielie were sent as envoys to Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬午，晉使及諸國使來見。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Jin envoys and envoys from the various states came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day envoys from Jin and from the tributary states were received at court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day jiashen, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiashen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 幸平地松林，觀潢水源。

translations.literal: He went to Pingdi Pine Forest and viewed the source of the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: He traveled to Pingdi Pine Forest to view the Huang River's source.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，幸頻蹕淀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day jiayin, he went to Pinbi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin day, he went to Pinbi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 壬申，震開皇殿。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Kaihuang Hall was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Kaihuang Hall was shaken.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，晉遣戶部尚書聶延祚等請上尊號，及歸雁門以北與幽、薊之地，仍歲貢帛三十萬疋，詔不許。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day jiashen, Jin sent Minister of Revenue Nie Yanhuo and others to request that he accept an elevated title, return the lands north of Yanmen together with You and Ji, and continue submitting three hundred thousand bolts of cloth annually; an edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen day, Jin dispatched Minister of Revenue Nie Yanhuo and others to ask that he take an honorific title, restore the territory north of Yanmen along with You and Ji, and receive three hundred thousand bolts of silk each year; he refused by edict.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，侍中列率言，范延廣叛晉，引兵南向。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Attendant-in-Chief Lie Lüeyan reported that Fan Yanguang had rebelled against Jin and was leading troops south.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Attendant-in-Chief Lie Lüeyan reported that Fan Yanguang had turned against Jin and was marching south with his army.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，詔諸部治兵甲。

translations.literal: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh month of autumn, an edict ordered all tribes to prepare arms and armor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered every tribe to ready arms and armor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸懷州，謁奉陵。

translations.literal: On day guichou, he went to Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Fengling.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day he went to Huai Prefecture and visited Fengling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，晉遣使來告范延廣反。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Jin sent envoys reporting Fan Yanguang's rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Jin sent envoys announcing that Fan Yanguang had rebelled.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣耶律褭古里使晉議軍事。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yelü Niaoguli was dispatched to Jin to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yelü Niaoguli was sent to Jin to consult on military matters.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，晉遣使復請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day guiwei, Jin again sent envoys requesting an elevated title; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei day, Jin again sent envoys asking for an honorific title; he again refused.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，晉及太原劉知遠、南唐李?各遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jin, Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan, and Li Jing of Southern Tang each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Jin, Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan, and Li Jing of Southern Tang all dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚子，晉遣使以都汴及范延廣降來告。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Jin sent envoys announcing that the capital was at Bian and that Fan Yanguang had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jin sent envoys reporting that the court had moved to Bian and that Fan Yanguang had submitted.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day renzi, the Bigude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, the Bigude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣直里古使晉及南唐。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Zhiligu was dispatched as envoy to Jin and Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Zhiligu was sent as envoy to Jin and Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，朮不姑、女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Shibugu and Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Shibugu and Jurchen came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣使高麗、鐵驪。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, envoys were dispatched to Goryeo and the Iron Li.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were sent to Goryeo and the Iron Li.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Uighur came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Uighur brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰朔，皇太后永寧節，晉及回鶻、燉煌諸國皆遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On the gengchen new moon of the tenth month of winter, the Grand Empress Dowager's Yongning Festival; Jin, the Uighur, Dunhuang, and other states all sent envoys with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the gengchen new moon of the tenth month, for the Grand Empress Dowager's Yongning Festival, Jin, the Uighur, Dunhuang, and other states all sent envoys to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔回鶻使胡離只、阿剌保，問其風俗。

translations.literal: On day renwu, an edict ordered the Uighur envoys Huluozhi and Alibao questioned about their customs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict directed that the Uighur envoys Huluozhi and Alibao be questioned about their people's customs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諸國使還，就遣蒲里骨皮室胡末里使其國。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, as the envoys of the various states returned, Puli Gu Pishi Humoli was sent out with them to their countries.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, as the foreign envoys took their leave, Puli Gu Pishi Humoli was dispatched with them to their homelands.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，遣使求醫于晉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day jiwei, envoys were dispatched to Jin to request a physician.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, envoys were sent to Jin to ask for a doctor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Iron Li came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Iron Li brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，東幸，祀木葉山。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day jiashen, he went east on tour and sacrificed at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiashen day, he toured eastward and offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 己丑，醫來。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the physician arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the physician came.
